<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Muhammad Tabina Zachary — Portfolio</title>
<meta content="Portfolio of Muhammad Tabina Zachary — Public Relations, Corporate Communication, Employer Branding, digital marketing, creative media, photography, videography, and social media." name="description"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,340;9..144,440;9..144,560;9..144,620&amp;family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&amp;family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#F2F0EA;
    --paper-raised:#FBFAF7;
    --ink:#1D1B18;
    --ink-soft:#4E4A44;
    --line:rgba(29,27,24,0.14);
    --line-soft:rgba(29,27,24,0.08);
    --gold:#B9812E;
    --gold-deep:#8F631F;
    --gold-tint:#F2E3C6;
    --green:#3C5B47;
    --max:1180px;
    --gutter:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);
    --radius:2px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation:none !important; transition:none !important;}
  }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,h4{
    font-family:'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight:560;
    margin:0;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  p{margin:0;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--max); margin:0 auto; padding-left:var(--gutter); padding-right:var(--gutter);}
  .section{padding:clamp(64px,9vw,128px) 0;}
  .section-border-top{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--gold-deep);
  }
  .lede{
    font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    max-width:640px;
    line-height:1.65;
  }
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    padding:13px 26px;
    border:1px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:14.5px;
    font-weight:500;
    text-decoration:none;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:transparent;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper-raised);}
  .btn.solid{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper-raised);}
  .btn.solid:hover{background:var(--gold-deep); border-color:var(--gold-deep); color:#fff;}
  .btn.gold{border-color:var(--gold-deep); color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .btn.gold:hover{background:var(--gold-deep); color:#fff;}

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(242,240,234,0.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    max-width:var(--max); margin:0 auto; padding:0 var(--gutter);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    height:68px;
  }
  .nav-mark{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:560; font-size:18px; text-decoration:none;}
  .nav-links{display:flex; gap:34px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .nav-links a{font-size:14.5px; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink-soft); position:relative; padding-bottom:3px;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  .nav-links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold-deep);transition:right .2s ease;}
  .nav-links a:hover::after{right:0;}
  .nav-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:6px;}
  .nav-toggle span{display:block; width:22px; height:1.5px; background:var(--ink); margin:5px 0;}
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .nav-links{position:fixed; top:68px; left:0; right:0; background:var(--paper-raised); flex-direction:column; gap:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .25s ease;}
    .nav-links.open{max-height:320px;}
    .nav-links li{width:100%;}
    .nav-links a{display:block; padding:16px var(--gutter); border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
    .nav-links a::after{display:none;}
    .nav-cta{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:block;}
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{padding:clamp(72px,12vw,140px) 0 clamp(56px,7vw,96px);}
  .hero-label{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:inline-block;
    padding:6px 14px;
    border-radius:20px;
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(38px,6.4vw,84px);
    line-height:1.04;
    max-width:15ch;
  }
  .hero-sub{
    margin-top:26px;
    font-size:clamp(16.5px,1.6vw,19px);
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    max-width:52ch;
  }
  .hero-actions{margin-top:38px; display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero-foot{
    margin-top:88px; padding-top:26px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);
  }

  /* ---------- ABOUT ---------- */
  .about-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr; gap:64px;}
  @media (max-width:860px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:36px;}}
  .about-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,44px); max-width:11ch;}
  .about-copy p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:17px; max-width:56ch;}
  .about-copy p + p{margin-top:16px;}
  .cap-list{margin-top:36px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .cap-list div{padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .cap-list div:nth-child(odd){padding-right:16px;}

  /* ---------- SECTION HEADS ---------- */
  .head-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:32px; margin-bottom:48px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .head-row h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px); max-width:16ch;}
  .head-row .lede{margin-bottom:0;}

  /* ---------- CASE STUDY COVER ---------- */
  .case-tag{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--gold-deep);
    border:1px solid var(--gold-deep); display:inline-block; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:20px; margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .case-title{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,96px); line-height:0.98;}
  .case-sub{margin-top:20px; font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px); color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:34ch; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:440;}
  .case-cover{
    margin-top:56px; height:clamp(220px,32vw,420px);
    background:
      linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(185,129,46,0.18), rgba(60,91,71,0.10)),
      repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(29,27,24,0.05) 0 2px, transparent 2px 34px);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; padding:28px;
  }
  .case-cover .cc-word{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,54px); color:var(--ink);}
  .meta-grid{margin-top:44px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .meta-grid div{border-right:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:18px 20px;}
  .meta-grid .k{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .meta-grid .v{margin-top:6px; font-size:15px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){.meta-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}

  /* ---------- CHALLENGE ---------- */
  .challenge{
    background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper);
  }
  .challenge h2{color:var(--paper); font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,48px); max-width:16ch; line-height:1.12;}
  .challenge p{color:rgba(242,240,234,0.78); font-size:17px; max-width:60ch; margin-top:22px;}
  .challenge .q{
    margin-top:44px; padding:30px 32px; border:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.25);
    font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,26px); font-weight:440; max-width:44ch; line-height:1.35;
  }

  /* ---------- RESEARCH ---------- */
  .research-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .research-row{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:70px 1fr 1.4fr; gap:24px; align-items:baseline;
    padding:26px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .research-row .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; color:var(--gold-deep); font-size:14px;}
  .research-row h4{font-size:19px; font-weight:560;}
  .research-row p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:17px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){.research-row{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:6px;}}
  .insight-card{
    margin-top:48px; padding:36px; background:var(--gold-tint); border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .insight-card p{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px); font-weight:440; line-height:1.35; max-width:38ch;}
  .footnote{margin-top:16px; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}

  /* ---------- PERSONA ---------- */
  .persona{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:280px 1fr; gap:56px; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:44px;
    background:var(--paper-raised);
  }
  @media (max-width:800px){.persona{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px; padding:28px;}}
  .persona-id{border-right:1px solid var(--line); padding-right:40px;}
  @media (max-width:800px){.persona-id{border-right:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-right:0; padding-bottom:24px;}}
  .persona-avatar{width:72px; height:72px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--green)); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .persona-id h3{font-size:28px;}
  .persona-id .meta{margin-top:6px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14.5px;}
  .persona-id ul{margin:20px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .persona-id li{font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:6px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
  .persona-cols{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:36px;}
  @media (max-width:520px){.persona-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .persona-cols h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--gold-deep); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .persona-cols ul{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .persona-cols li{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:9px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
  .persona-behavior{margin-top:32px; padding-top:28px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .behavior-row{display:flex; gap:18px; align-items:baseline; padding:8px 0; font-size:14.5px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .behavior-row b{min-width:90px; display:inline-block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:500; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink);}
  .behavior-row span{color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- BENCHMARK TABLE ---------- */
  table.bench{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:14.5px;}
  table.bench th, table.bench td{text-align:left; padding:16px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top;}
  table.bench th{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--ink-soft); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink);}
  table.bench td:first-child, table.bench th:first-child{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:560; font-size:16px; color:var(--ink);}
  .table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;}
  .takeaway{
    margin-top:40px; display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap;
    padding:28px 0 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .takeaway p{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,25px); font-weight:440; max-width:44ch; line-height:1.35;}

  /* ---------- EVP ---------- */
  .evp{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper);}
  .evp h2{color:var(--paper); font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,66px); max-width:14ch; line-height:1.06;}
  .evp-pillars{margin-top:56px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.2);}
  @media (max-width:860px){.evp-pillars{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.evp-pillars{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .pillar{padding:30px 26px; border-right:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.2); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.2);}
  .pillar h4{color:var(--gold); font-size:15px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .pillar p{margin-top:14px; color:rgba(242,240,234,0.82); font-size:15.5px; line-height:1.5;}
  .evp-flow{margin-top:56px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13px; color:rgba(242,240,234,0.7);}
  .evp-flow span.step{padding:9px 14px; border:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.3); border-radius:20px;}
  .evp-flow span.arrow{color:var(--gold);}

  /* ---------- FRAMEWORK TABLE ---------- */
  table.framework{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:15px;}
  table.framework th, table.framework td{padding:18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); text-align:left; vertical-align:top;}
  table.framework th{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--ink-soft); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink);}
  table.framework td:first-child{font-weight:600; color:var(--gold-deep);}

  /* ---------- CAMPAIGN ---------- */
  .campaign-title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:620; font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,92px); line-height:1;}
  .funnel{margin-top:48px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .funnel-step{flex:1 1 140px; padding:22px 18px; text-align:left; border-right:1px solid var(--line); position:relative;}
  .funnel-step:last-child{border-right:none;}
  .funnel-step .n{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .funnel-step .t{margin-top:8px; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:17px;}

  /* ---------- CONTENT PILLARS ---------- */
  .pillar-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media (max-width:1000px){.pillar-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media (max-width:560px){.pillar-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .pillar-cell{border-right:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:26px 22px; min-height:220px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .pillar-cell .n{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .pillar-cell h4{margin-top:10px; font-size:17px; line-height:1.2;}
  .pillar-cell ul{margin:16px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none; flex:1;}
  .pillar-cell li{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:6px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}

  /* ---------- CHANNEL CARDS ---------- */
  .channels{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media (max-width:860px){.channels{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .channel{border-right:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:34px 30px;}
  .channel h3{font-size:24px;}
  .channel .purpose{margin-top:8px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--gold-deep); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
  .channel ul{margin:22px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .channel li{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:7px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
  .channel .tone{margin-top:22px; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; font-family:'Fraunces',serif;}

  /* ---------- MOCKUPS ---------- */
  .mockups{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:32px;}
  @media (max-width:960px){.mockups{grid-template-columns:1fr; max-width:360px; margin:0 auto;}}
  .phone{
    border:8px solid var(--ink); border-radius:26px; background:var(--paper-raised); overflow:hidden; max-width:300px; margin:0 auto;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ink);
  }
  .phone-top{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .phone-top .dot{width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--green));}
  .phone-top .who{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;}
  .phone-top .app{margin-left:auto; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .phone-media{aspect-ratio:4/5; background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(29,27,24,0.05) 0 10px, rgba(29,27,24,0.02) 10px 20px); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px; text-align:center;}
  .phone-media p{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:18px; line-height:1.3;}
  .phone-body{padding:14px;}
  .phone-body .cap{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.5;}
  .phone-body .icons{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
  .mock-caption{margin-top:16px; text-align:center; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .li-post{border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper-raised); max-width:340px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px;}
  .li-post .head{display:flex; gap:12px;}
  .li-post .dot{width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--gold)); flex-shrink:0;}
  .li-post .name{font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;}
  .li-post .role{font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .li-post .body{margin-top:14px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.55;}
  .li-post .foot{margin-top:16px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}

  /* ---------- ADVOCACY ---------- */
  .advocacy{background:var(--gold-tint); border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .advocacy-inner{padding:56px;}
  @media (max-width:700px){.advocacy-inner{padding:32px 24px;}}
  .advoc-flow{margin-top:40px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13px;}
  .advoc-flow span.step{padding:9px 14px; background:var(--paper-raised); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px;}
  .advoc-flow span.arrow{color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .advoc-story{margin-top:36px; padding:26px 28px; background:var(--paper-raised); border-left:3px solid var(--gold-deep);}
  .advoc-story p{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:19px;}
  .advoc-becomes{margin-top:20px; display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .advoc-becomes span{font-size:13px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px; color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- CALENDAR ---------- */
  .cal-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:20px;}
  @media (max-width:860px){.cal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media (max-width:560px){.cal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .cal-week{border:1px solid var(--line); padding:22px;}
  .cal-week h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--gold-deep); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .cal-week ul{margin:16px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .cal-week li{font-size:13.5px; padding:10px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft); color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .cal-week li b{display:block; color:var(--ink); font-weight:500; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:2px;}

  /* ---------- JOURNEY ---------- */
  .journey{display:flex; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .journey-step{display:grid; grid-template-columns:170px 1fr; gap:20px; padding:22px 26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); align-items:center;}
  .journey-step:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  @media (max-width:600px){.journey-step{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:6px;}}
  .journey-step .stage{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:19px; color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .journey-step .detail{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- KPI ---------- */
  .kpi-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media (max-width:860px){.kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .kpi-cell{border-right:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:26px 22px;}
  .kpi-cell h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .kpi-cell .figure{margin-top:14px; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:26px; color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .kpi-cell .figure + .figure{margin-top:6px;}
  .disclaimer{margin-top:32px; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:18px;}

  /* ---------- IMPACT LIST ---------- */
  .impact-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .impact-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:60px 1fr; gap:20px; padding:24px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .impact-row .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; color:var(--gold-deep); font-size:13px;}
  .impact-row p{font-size:16.5px; max-width:52ch;}

  /* ---------- ROLE ---------- */
  .role-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:56px;}
  @media (max-width:800px){.role-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:32px;}}
  .role-grid ul{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .role-grid li{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:11px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
  .skill-strip{margin-top:44px; padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13.5px; letter-spacing:.02em; color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- CAPABILITIES ---------- */
  .capgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media (max-width:800px){.capgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .capcell{border-right:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:28px 26px;}
  .capcell h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .capcell ul{margin:18px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  .capcell li{font-size:15px; padding:8px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft); color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- EXPERIENCE ---------- */
  .exp-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .exp-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 260px; gap:20px; padding:26px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); align-items:baseline;}
  @media (max-width:700px){.exp-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .exp-row h4{font-size:19px;}
  .exp-row .role{margin-top:4px; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .exp-row .focus{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--gold-deep); text-align:right;}
  @media (max-width:700px){.exp-row .focus{text-align:left;}}

  /* ---------- CLOSING ---------- */
  .closing{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); text-align:left;}
  .closing h2{color:var(--paper); font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,54px); max-width:18ch; line-height:1.18;}
  .closing h2.line2{color:rgba(242,240,234,0.55); font-weight:440;}
  .closing-foot{margin-top:64px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,0.2); padding-top:32px;}
  .closing-foot .name{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:20px;}
  .closing-foot .role{margin-top:6px; font-size:13.5px; color:rgba(242,240,234,0.6);}

  footer.site{padding:36px var(--gutter); text-align:center; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}


  /* ---------- FINAL CONTACT ---------- */
  .contact-final{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:clamp(78px,10vw,140px) 0 34px;}
  .contact-inner{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;}
  .contact-kicker{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;}
  .contact-inner h2{color:var(--paper);font-size:clamp(46px,8vw,96px);line-height:.98;margin-top:20px;max-width:12ch;}
  .contact-role{margin-top:24px;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:clamp(19px,2.1vw,25px);color:rgba(242,240,234,.88);}
  .contact-copy{margin-top:18px;max-width:720px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;color:rgba(242,240,234,.68);}
  .contact-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 28px;margin-top:34px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.18);}
  .contact-links a{color:var(--paper);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.35);padding-bottom:3px;}
  .contact-links a:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);}
  .contact-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:38px;padding:14px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.5);color:var(--paper);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;}
  .contact-button:hover{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--paper);}
  .contact-button span{font-size:18px;line-height:1;}
  .contact-foot{margin-top:90px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.14);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:rgba(242,240,234,.42);}


  /* NOVA contrast safety */
  .nova-full .advocacy,.nova-full .insight-card,.nova-full .persona,.nova-full .cal-week,.nova-full .journey,.nova-full .kpi-grid,.nova-full .li-post,.nova-full .phone{color:var(--ink);}
  .nova-full .advocacy h1,.nova-full .advocacy h2,.nova-full .advocacy h3,.nova-full .advocacy h4,.nova-full .advocacy h5,
  .nova-full .insight-card h1,.nova-full .insight-card h2,.nova-full .insight-card h3,.nova-full .insight-card h4,.nova-full .insight-card h5,
  .nova-full .persona h1,.nova-full .persona h2,.nova-full .persona h3,.nova-full .persona h4,.nova-full .persona h5,
  .nova-full .cal-week h1,.nova-full .cal-week h2,.nova-full .cal-week h3,.nova-full .cal-week h4,.nova-full .cal-week h5,
  .nova-full .li-post h1,.nova-full .li-post h2,.nova-full .li-post h3,.nova-full .li-post h4,.nova-full .li-post h5{color:var(--ink);}
  .nova-full .advocacy p,.nova-full .advocacy li,.nova-full .insight-card p,.nova-full .persona p,.nova-full .persona li,.nova-full .cal-week li,.nova-full .li-post .body,.nova-full .li-post .role,.nova-full .li-post .foot{color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .nova-full .advocacy .eyebrow,.nova-full .insight-card .eyebrow{color:var(--gold-deep);}

  /* reveal */
  .reveal{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1; transform:none;}

  ::selection{background:var(--gold-tint); color:var(--ink);}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-deep); outline-offset:2px;}

  .nova-teaser{padding:clamp(54px,7vw,92px) 0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);}
  .nova-teaser .eyebrow{color:var(--gold);}
  .nova-card{border:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.22);padding:clamp(26px,4vw,48px);margin-top:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);}
  .nova-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;align-items:flex-start;}
  .nova-top h2{color:var(--paper);font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,88px);line-height:.95;}
  .nova-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,240,234,.62);margin-top:12px;}
  .nova-note{max-width:700px;color:rgba(242,240,234,.78);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin-top:22px;}
  .nova-summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.18);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--gold);}
  .nova-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  .nova-summary::after{content:'＋';font-size:18px;line-height:1;}
  details[open] > .nova-summary::after{content:'−';}
  .nova-full{margin-top:36px;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,234,.14);}
  .nova-full .section{padding-left:0;padding-right:0;}
  .nova-full .section:first-child{padding-top:0;}
  /* Keep each NOVA subsection's own background/text contrast. Only the dark challenge section gets light text. */
  .nova-full .challenge h1,.nova-full .challenge h2,.nova-full .challenge h3,.nova-full .challenge h4,.nova-full .challenge h5{color:var(--paper);}
  .nova-full .challenge p,.nova-full .challenge li,.nova-full .challenge .lede{color:rgba(242,240,234,.82);}
  .nova-full .challenge .eyebrow{color:var(--gold);}
  .nova-full .challenge .q{color:var(--paper);}
  .nova-full .challenge .footnote{color:rgba(242,240,234,.58);}
  .nova-full .challenge{background:var(--ink);}
  .nova-full .case-cover{color:var(--paper);}
  .nova-full .case-cover{background:#121212;}
  .nova-full .case-tag,.nova-full .eyebrow{color:var(--gold);}
  .portfolio-intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:end;}
  .portfolio-intro h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.02;margin-top:10px;}
  .portfolio-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:42px;}
  .portfolio-stat{padding:20px 18px 20px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--line);}
  .portfolio-stat:last-child{border-right:0;padding-left:18px;}
  .portfolio-stat:not(:first-child){padding-left:18px;}
  .portfolio-stat .num{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:36px;line-height:1;}
  .portfolio-stat .label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .portfolio-categories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:52px;}
  .portfolio-category{padding:25px 26px 28px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;display:block;transition:transform .2s ease;}
  .portfolio-category:nth-child(even){padding-left:26px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-right:0;}
  .portfolio-category:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .portfolio-category .index{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .portfolio-category h3{font-size:28px;margin-top:8px;}
  .portfolio-category p{color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:6px;font-size:14px;}
  .archive-intro{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:50px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:48px;}
  .archive-intro h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.5vw,58px);line-height:1;max-width:700px;}
  .archive-note{max-width:430px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;}
  .archive-group{margin-top:70px;scroll-margin-top:90px;}
  .archive-group:first-of-type{margin-top:0;}
  .archive-group-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:baseline;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:13px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .archive-group-head h3{font-size:26px;}
  .archive-group-head span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .page-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;}
  .page-card{margin:0;background:var(--paper-raised);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;}
  .page-card a{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:#111;}
  .page-card img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .35s ease;}
  .page-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.018);}
  .page-card figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 12px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .video-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:18px;}
  .video-link{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 16px;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;background:var(--paper-raised);}
  .video-link small{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--gold-deep);white-space:nowrap;}
  .contact-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:18px;}
  .contact-strip a{padding:12px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;background:var(--paper-raised);}
  .contact-strip a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-deep);}
  @media(max-width:800px){.nova-top{display:block}.portfolio-intro,.archive-intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.portfolio-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.portfolio-stat,.portfolio-stat:not(:first-child),.portfolio-stat:last-child{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}.portfolio-stat:last-child{border-bottom:0}.portfolio-categories{grid-template-columns:1fr}.portfolio-category,.portfolio-category:nth-child(even){padding:22px 0;border-left:0}.page-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.video-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  @media(max-width:520px){.page-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nova-card{padding:22px 18px}}



/* ---------- FINAL PORTFOLIO REFINEMENTS ---------- */
.section-title-large{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);line-height:1.02;margin:12px 0 48px;max-width:14ch;}
.experience-block{margin-top:20px;}
.org-block{margin-top:72px;}
.experience-block-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:0;}
.experience-count{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.experience-block .exp-list{border-top:0;}
.experience-block .exp-row{padding:24px 0;}
.education-list{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.education-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px 1fr;gap:40px;padding:30px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.education-date{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--gold-deep);padding-top:5px;}
.education-item h3{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px);}
.education-item p{margin-top:7px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:17px;}
.education-item span{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
.skill-item{padding:28px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:190px;background:var(--paper-raised);}
.skill-item>span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--gold-deep);font-size:11px;}
.skill-item h3{font-size:23px;margin-top:22px;}
.skill-item p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;}
.portfolio-categories-clean{margin-top:48px;}
.archive-kicker{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--gold-deep);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;}
.archive-group-head h3{margin-top:0;}
.page-card figcaption{background:var(--paper-raised);}
/* High-contrast NOVA: dark surfaces always use light text; light surfaces always use dark text. */
.nova-teaser{background:#151412;color:#F8F6F1;}
.nova-teaser h1,.nova-teaser h2,.nova-teaser h3,.nova-teaser h4,.nova-teaser h5{color:#F8F6F1;}
.nova-teaser p,.nova-teaser li{color:#D8D5CE;}
.nova-teaser .nova-label{color:#D8B16B;}
.nova-teaser .nova-note{color:#E2DFD8;}
.nova-teaser .nova-summary{color:#D8B16B;border-color:rgba(248,246,241,.28);}
.nova-full{color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);}
.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp){background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);}
.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) h1,.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) h2,.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) h3,.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) h4,.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) h5{color:var(--ink);}
.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) p,.nova-full>section:not(.challenge):not(.evp) li{color:var(--ink-soft);}
.nova-full .challenge,.nova-full .evp{background:#171614;color:#F8F6F1;}
.nova-full .challenge h1,.nova-full .challenge h2,.nova-full .challenge h3,.nova-full .challenge h4,.nova-full .challenge h5,.nova-full .evp h1,.nova-full .evp h2,.nova-full .evp h3,.nova-full .evp h4,.nova-full .evp h5{color:#F8F6F1;}
.nova-full .challenge p,.nova-full .challenge li,.nova-full .evp p,.nova-full .evp li{color:#D8D5CE;}
.nova-full .case-cover{background:#11100F!important;color:#F8F6F1!important;}
.nova-full .case-cover .cc-word{color:#F8F6F1!important;}
.nova-full .case-tag,.nova-full .eyebrow{color:#A96F1D;}
.nova-full .challenge .eyebrow,.nova-full .evp .eyebrow{color:#D8B16B;}
@media(max-width:860px){.education-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.experience-block-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.skill-item{min-height:auto}.education-item{padding:24px 0}}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ============ NOVA DIGITAL TEASER ============ -->
<section class="nova-teaser reveal" id="nova"><div class="wrap"><span class="eyebrow">Featured Self-Initiated Case Study</span><div class="nova-card"><div class="nova-top"><div><h2>NOVA Digital</h2><div class="nova-label">Employer Branding · Talent Communication · Content Strategy</div></div><div class="case-tag">Hypothetical Project · 2026</div></div><p class="nova-note"><strong>NOVA Digital is a hypothetical company created for this self-initiated case study.</strong> This project explores how an employer brand can communicate culture, career growth, people, and employee experience to Gen Z talent.</p><details><summary class="nova-summary">Open full NOVA Digital case study <span>View project</span></summary><div class="nova-full"><!-- ============ FEATURED CASE STUDY COVER ============ -->
<section class="section section-border-top reveal" id="work">
<div class="wrap">
<span class="eyebrow">Featured Case Study</span>
<div class="case-tag">Self-Initiated Employer Branding Case Study — Hypothetical Project, 2026</div>
<h2 class="case-title">NOVA Digital</h2>
<p class="case-sub">Building an Employer Brand That Gen Z Wants to Join</p>
<div class="case-cover">
<span class="cc-word">NOVA</span>
<span class="cc-word" style="color:var(--gold-deep);">Digital</span>
</div>
<div class="meta-grid">
<div><div class="k">Industry</div><div class="v">Technology &amp; Digital Services</div></div>
<div><div class="k">Audience</div><div class="v">Gen Z / Early-Career Talent</div></div>

<div><div class="k">Year</div><div class="v">2026</div></div>

<!-- ============ CHALLENGE ============ -->
<section class="challenge section reveal">
<div class="wrap">
<span class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--gold);">The Business Challenge</span>
<h2>The challenge wasn't recruitment. It was perception.</h2>
<p>NOVA Digital is a hypothetical growing technology company looking to strengthen its position as an attractive workplace for young talent. Although NOVA offers career development opportunities and exposure to innovative projects, its employer brand communication is inconsistent and heavily focused on corporate announcements and recruitment vacancies. Potential candidates have limited visibility into what it is actually like to work at NOVA.</p>
<div class="q">"How can NOVA build an authentic employer brand that makes Gen Z understand, trust, and ultimately want to join the company?"</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ RESEARCH & INSIGHTS ============ -->
<section class="section section-border-top reveal">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="head-row">
<div>
<span class="eyebrow">Research &amp; Insights</span>
<h2>Understanding what talent actually looks for.</h2>
</div>
<p class="lede">Five considerations used to frame the strategy for this case study.</p>
</div>
<div class="research-list">
<div class="research-row"><div class="num">01</div><h4>Career Growth</h4><p>"Will I actually grow here?"</p></div>
<div class="research-row"><div class="num">02</div><h4>People &amp; Culture</h4><p>"Who will I be working with?"</p></div>
<div class="research-row"><div class="num">03</div><h4>Meaningful Work</h4><p>"Will my work have an impact?"</p></div>
<div class="research-row"><div class="num">04</div><h4>Work Environment</h4><p>"Will I enjoy working here?"</p></div>
<div class="research-row"><div class="num">05</div><h4>Employer Credibility</h4><p>"Can I trust what the company says about itself?"</p></div>
</div>
<div class="insight-card">
<p>"Gen Z doesn't only want to know what a company does. They want to know what their life will look like if they work there."</p>
</div>
<p class="footnote">These are strategic assumptions and portfolio research insights, not findings from a real survey.</p>
</div>
</section>

<div class="table-scroll">

</thead>

<tr><td>Google</td><td>Very strong, globally recognized</td><td>Polished, mission-led</td><td>Aspirational</td><td>Frequent, high-production</td><td>Compete on relatability, not scale</td></tr>

<script>
  const toggle=document.getElementById('navToggle'); const links=document.getElementById('navLinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=links.classList.toggle('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');});
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{links.classList.remove('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}));
  const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}})},{threshold:.12});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  document.querySelectorAll('.image-open').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();const img=a.querySelector('img');if(img)window.open(img.src,'_blank','noopener');}));
</script>
